assistant.guide: Type what you want to pull. Images, APT, Go modules and GitHub assets all work.
assistant.persistent: Tired of editing commands? Point the upstream address in your config at the katch prefix instead.

metrics.trendLabel: Hit rate over the last 14 days

matrix.title: Upstream health
matrix.hint: Bars are requests over the last 12 hours. Click to open an upstream.

kind.upstream_degraded: {{host}} kept failing at the origin and backed off
kind.upstream_degraded_unknown: An upstream kept failing at the origin and backed off
kind.upstream_recovered_unknown: An upstream serves from the origin again
kind.git_mirror_pending_unknown: A repository started building a local mirror
kind.git_mirror_ready_unknown: A repository's local mirror finished building

kind.git_mirror_rejected_unknown: A repository exceeds the per-repo size limit, staying passthrough
kind.git_mirror_evicted_unknown: Mirror quota exceeded, reclaimed a repository
kind.unknown: An event this build does not know yet

upstream.missing: This upstream is gone — it may have been deleted.
upstream.chartLabel: Cache hits and origin requests over the last {{range}}

missReasons.title: Origin fetch reasons
missReasons.empty: No origin fetches in this window

form.cachePolicyHint: A preset only fills the patterns below; the saved request carries the patterns, not the preset name.
form.ttlInvalid: TTL must be a non-negative integer

error.unreachable: Cannot reach this katch, so nothing was saved. Check that the service is still running.
error.rejected: The backend did not accept this change.
error.upstreamNotFound: This upstream no longer exists. Refresh and try again.
error.upstreamHostExists: An upstream with this host already exists.
error.ruleNotFound: That rule is gone. Refresh and try again.
error.purgeTargetRequired: Say which object or which upstream to purge.
error.settingKeyUnknown: One setting is unknown to this katch — the UI may be newer than the backend.
error.settingValueInvalid: One setting has a value outside the allowed range. Fix it and save again.

rules.title: Access rules
rules.globalSubtitle: Evaluated before every upstream's own rules

policyHint.allow_all: Requests no rule matches are proxied as usual
policyHint.deny_unless_matched: Requests no rule matches get a 403

rules.globalScopeHint: These rules are evaluated before every upstream's own rules
rules.globalCount: {{total}} global rule(s) are evaluated before this table
rules.testerHint: Paste a resource address and see which rule decides it. No real request is made.

verdictDefault.allow_all: No rule matched, so the default policy applies: allow everything
verdictDefault.deny_unless_matched: No rule matched, so the default policy applies: only what rules allow

rules.traceFootnote: Rules are evaluated by specificity, not by the order they were added: the longer literal prefix wins, then the one with fewer wildcards, and deny wins a tie.

cache.title: Cache objects
cache.addressing: Content addressed — one copy per layer

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Runtime settings only — every change takes effect right away, no restart
settings.configNoticeLead: Listen address, database and logging live in
settings.configNoticeTail: , not here; changing them needs a process restart.
settings.unreadableValue: One value is unreadable. Write it like 3 TB, 512 MB, 5m or 30s.

hints.siteDomain: The domain users pull from; also used to build commands
hints.publicHomepage: Off: the homepage keeps only the input box, no upstreams or hit rate
hints.quota: Crossing the watermark starts LRU reclaim
hints.mutableTTL: Manifests, Release files, @latest — the objects that change
hints.recentRequestRetention: The only gate on how much disk this history takes: the longer the retention, the bigger the database, growing linearly with traffic
hints.immutable: Content addressed, never expires, evicted by LRU only
hints.concurrency: Requests hitting one upstream at the same time
hints.globalRules: Evaluated before every upstream's own rules
hints.gitQuota: Total disk the local git mirrors may take
hints.gitRepoLimit: Repositories over this stay on passthrough and are never mirrored
hints.gitSyncTimeout: How long one incremental sync may run; builds have their own limit
hints.gitBuildStall: Abort a build once the upstream has sent nothing for this long
hints.gitBuildTimeout: How long one mirror build may take, queueing included

states.publicOn: Upstreams and hit rate are visible to everyone
states.publicOff: The homepage keeps only the input box
states.immutable: Decided by the content digest, not configurable

login.title: Admin sign-in
login.pitch: One domain in front of every upstream. Container images, APT, Go modules and GitHub releases — cached once, shared by everyone.
login.subtitle: Enter the admin key. On first start it is the initial key from config.yaml; rotate it in settings once you are in.
login.invalid: That key does not get you in. The admin API answers a wrong key and a missing key exactly the same way, so this is all anyone can tell.
login.unreachable: Cannot reach this katch. Check that the service is still running.
login.loopbackNotice: The admin API listens on 127.0.0.1 only by default. If you expose it through a reverse proxy, add your own layer of authentication.
